translation: Flavor pungent, greatly cold, non-toxic. It mainly treats heat binding of food and drink in the stomach, breaks retained blood and closure and severance, and stops phlegm stagnation and fullness; it expels the old and brings forth the new. Refined, it is like silver; it can be cold, can be hot, can be slippery, can be astringent, can be pungent, can be bitter, can be salty, can be sour.
